intro: Give your dining space a touch of timeless warmth. With a solid frame and cushioned seat, the Atlantis chairs invite you to linger longer over meals with family and friends.

features.title: Solid wood strength
features.text: Crafted with a durable rubberwood frame in a walnut shade, these chairs are built to last and bring natural warmth to your dining space.

features.title: Cushioned comfort seat
features.text: High-density foam ensures your seat stays soft yet supportive, so you stay comfortable through long dinners and conversations.

features.title: Supportive angular backrest
features.text: The cushioned backrest is designed at an angle to provide ergonomic support, helping you sit comfortably without strain.

features.title: Elegant walnut finish
features.text: The rich walnut shade adds depth and sophistication, blending easily with classic or modern dining tables and interiors.

features.title: Inviting sea-blue upholstery
features.text: The sea-blue polyester fabric brings a refreshing pop of color, brightening your dining area while staying soft and durable.

features.title: Floor-friendly design
features.text: Rubber bushes under the legs protect your floor from scratches and ensure steady balance, keeping your setup looking perfect.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
